purpose: Isolate proxy appearance in depth while checking unchanged GPU LiDAR and collision definitions

conditions_detail.baseline: Original proxy visual flags, low/high camera all-visible; native and noise-free diagnostic LiDAR
conditions_detail.masked: Proxy visuals tagged flag0x00000004; simultaneous all-visible and proxy-excluded camera at each height; both LiDARs all-visible; all collision elements retained
conditions_detail.null_visuals: Human actor/proxy visuals absent as diagnostic negative control; all collision elements retained; low/high camera and LiDARs

scope: Frozen recorded positions and actor animation_time0; no Nav2, robot drive, native human policy, default sensor change or training
metrics: Depth baseline vs all-mask in tagged world
Depth proxy-excluded vs null-visual control proves retained human geometry
Noise-free LiDAR baseline vs tagged world
Native LiDAR raw differences (nominal source noise retained)
BEV observed regions and conservative-proxy conflicts
limits: Depth mask success is not proof of real human appearance or train readiness
LiDAR keeps conservative cylinder while depth sees mesh; modality geometry mismatch must be reported
Structural collision parity is not a dynamic contact test
3 static poses are not a navigation or social behavior benchmark
amendment: run01/02 used reserved selection flag0x10000000, causing both depth cameras to exclude proxy; retained invalid setup. Final user layer uses non-reserved0x4, still same geometry and unchanged stability tolerance.
